title: Internal error - AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'node'
body:
Running mypy on this example fails with an internal error:

```
if __name__ == '__main__':
    serversList = []
    for i in serversList:
        def to_s(val):
            if not isinstance(val, basestring):
                return "%s (%s)" % (val, type(val))
            return "%s" % val
        to_s("s")
```
